Meta AI Executive Warns of Superintelligence Arrival

A top executive at Meta's AI division has warned that artificial superintelligence is 'arriving'. Alexandr Wang, chief AI officer at Meta, stated that the remaining challenges for AI to surpass human capabilities globally are no longer related to intelligence itself, but rather to 'domain-specific know-how, plumbing, and experimentation.' This perspective was contrasted by Yann LeCun, a former Meta AI chief and a figure in AI development, who described a different mindset as 'medieval' and questioned an OpenAI exit.
